verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs describe a chat UI, CLI (chat/get/load/server commands), and REST API for single-model interactions, but there is no mention of any batch/bulk processing feature (e.g., running many prompts, files, or downloads in one operation) in the docs or community evidence. The axis is plausible for a local-LLM tool (a REST API could support scripted batch calls), but no evidence shows this capability exists.
